Manages a diverse team of highly skilled analysts responsible for analyzing, developing, and implementing key areas of the University's systemwide budget, with particular emphasis on tuition and fee policy, student services, and enrollment management. Establishes objectives and work plans for the unit. Evaluates and produces both qualitative and quantitative analytical outputs. Utilizes data science tools. Responsible for managing, preparing, administering, and directing resources. Reviews and approves recommendations for functional programs. Involved in developing, modifying, and executing policies that affect immediate operation(s) and may also have organization-wide effect. Erroneous decisions or failure to achieve goals results in additional costs, inadequate resources, and/or serious delays in overall schedules with significant consequences for campuses or for the University as a whole.

50% Manages a team of highly skilled analysts responsible for complex policy and quantitative analysis, development, and implementation affecting multiple areas of the University's systemwide operating budget, including student tuition and fees, financial aid, student services, and enrollment management.

10% Oversees, contributes to, and directs preparation of responses to inquiries from Board of Regents, the President, other senior UC managers, governmental representatives, and other internal and external entities.

15% Initiates communications and collaborates with decision-makers across UC, at public agencies, and in the community to develop and implement solutions aligned with the University's strategic goals to address highly complex and/or controversial issues.

20% Oversees and contributes to highly complex analyses and projects with UC-wide influence, requiring facilitation and collaboration with representation across functions/locations, along with the use of data science tools.

5% Conducts and presents analyses to senior managers at the Office of the President and campuses in order to persuade, influence, or negotiate methods and objectives for complex projects or proposals with systemwide impact.
Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy.
Excellent understanding of campus and systemwide budgetary systems and policies.
Demonstrated leadership, expertise, and sensitivity to a highly complex political landscape in order to develop and advocate for the systemwide budget within UC and externally.
5% May be asked to travel to a campus on occasion.
Excellent communication, organization, supervisory, and project management skills.
Advanced written and verbal communication and presentation skills to convey complex information in a clear, concise, and compelling way.

Demonstrated ability to establish priorities, objectives, and timelines, including the ability to delegate and oversee assignments to ensure successful completion and to obtain the cooperation of others within and outside of the department.
Ability to work in a collaborative manner as a member of a team to achieve results.
Demonstrated ability to think strategically and to develop plans in an environment of ambiguity, risk, and urgency.
Expert knowledge in data collection and analysis techniques, including the use of statistics, statistical software, and/or social science research techniques.
Demonstrated ability to exercise good judgment, to make difficult decisions, and to develop creative solutions to complex problems.
Excellent active listening, critical thinking, multitasking, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion.
Strong knowledge of all aspects of written communications, including grammar, syntax, style, and punctuation.
Demonstrated ability to use very strong political acumen and influence across all levels of the organization to achieve results that are critical to the success of departmental objectives.
